verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API-driven sandbox platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents SDKs, a CLI, llms.txt, markdown docs and Cursor rule files, but nothing about an interactive API explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at every candidate path. These adjacent docs and tooling features earn no credit toward this story.
